event.distribution_pattern: Finished products were sold in WA only

products.product_description: Organic Chevre sold at Farmer's Market in plastic 6 oz tubs, vacuum-sealed with lid and label on top of tub, Sunny Pine Farm brand. Product also sold to in 2 lbs. and 3 lbs. to restaurant. Product is labeled in parts: "***Organic Goat Dairy***Chevre***SUNNY PINE FARM***6 oz***Pasteurized Organic Goat Milk, Salt, Rennet, and Culture***Keep refrigerated***Handcrafted in Twisp, Washington 98856***.
products.product_quantity: 121/6 oz. packages.; 2/2 lbs. packages; 11/3 lbs. packages
products.code_info: Expiration dates of products sold to non-restaurant consignees: 10/16/2013. Expiration dates of products sold to restaurants: 10/23/13 and 11/5/13. Chevre cheese products sold at Methow Valley Farmers Market (aka Twisp Farmers Market) between 7/27/13 and 10/12/13 were NOT labeled with an expiration date.
products.reason_for_recall: Sunny Pine Farm of Twisp, Washington is voluntarily recalling Organic Chevre due to possible improper pasteurization.
